newsitem.title: USA: Jay Jacobs June same store sales up 17 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jay Jacobs June same store sales up 17 pct.

text.p: Jay Jacobs Inc Wednesday said June sales totaled just over $6.1 million with same store sales rising 17 percent compared to June 1996.
Sales for the first five months topped $24.3 million with comparable store sales for the period up nine percent from June 1996.
"June comparable store sales represents a significant endorsement of our merchandise strategy by our customer," Rex Steffey, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
Jay Jacobs is a specialty retailer of men's and women's apparel with 114 stores in 20 states.
